$comment: Capabilities summary for Lexicon, so a checkout is self-describing. The generated, always-current manifest is served at https://lexicon.ashlr.ai/capabilities.json; this file is the stable pointer copy and deliberately carries no version or counts.
name: lexicon
description: Personal lexicon for voice-to-agents. Maps canonical spellings to what speech-to-text actually writes and rewrites transcripts before an agent sees them.
capabilities: normalize a dictated transcript and report every correction
learn a 'heard X, meant Y' correction as an alias
add a term with generated misspelling candidates
run guided or non-interactive first-time setup
install or preview the MCP server registration per client
harvest proper nouns from a repository
serve a loopback HTTP API on 127.0.0.1
